summary: 10.0.38.04 Dynamic Table Auto-Fit & Side Panel Viewport Parity: Desktop allocateDense Algorithm, Proportional Dense Floor Compression, Zero Horizontal Scroll, Word-Boundary Multi-Line Header Wrapping & Universal Register Drawer Coordination across 22 Modules
highlights: 1. Desktop Dynamic Table Parity (allocateDense): Implemented exact mathematical algorithm from DynamicTableLayoutManager.java, dynamically fitting all 12-14 columns into remaining available width when side drawers open.

2. Eliminated Horizontal Scrollbar: Locked table width strictly to 100% and removed destructive fixed-pixel floorTotal min-width overrides, eliminating right-to-left scrolling across all operational registers.
3. Compact Dense Floors: Aligned semantic floor values with Desktop JavaFX (denseFloor 44px-66px, actions 96px, select 36px) so all columns remain visible simultaneously.
4. Word-Boundary Multi-Line Header Wrapping: Ensured table headers wrap cleanly without awkward word breaks or clipping.
5. Universal Side Drawer Coordination: Connected RegisterUiSupport showDrawer and hideDrawer to DynamicTableLayoutManager across all 22 registered screens with side drawers.
6. Cell Text Ellipsis with Native Tooltips: Data cells truncate with clean ellipsis and provide native browser hover tooltips for complete content readability.
